svg.title: Kit dependency Gantt
svg.desc: Ordinal dependency tiers, not elapsed time or promised delivery dates. Every bar is one task, not a duration. Status and ownership are dated register observations.

g.text: Dependency Gantt — no calendar estimates assigned
Register observations; source gates and evidence still apply · red blocked · ochre active/checking · green recorded complete
B01 · Supported version, feature and route matrix
active · Codex B01 matrix worker; scoped delivery below

rect.title: B01: Every intended family has explicit file types, vendor versions, feature scope and directional routes, with evidence or named gaps.

g.text: blocked · PR #94 register: A02d, A04c, A05c

rect.title: B02: Initial paired sketches, bosses and cuts have independent inventories, resolved bindings and measured controls.

g.text: B03 · Graph comparison and proven format rules
blocked · PR #94 register: A06, A07, A09

rect.title: B03: Ambiguities, field rules and counterexamples are traceable. Qualified comparisons and held-out codecs pass remote gates.

g.text: blocked · PR #94 register: A11, A12; coordinate PR #121

rect.title: B04: Both writers derive every byte and required relationship from portable semantics, without donor blocks or a CAD runtime.
B05: Both initial directions pass public SDK, preservation, independent edits, restore, rebuild, save and fresh-process reopen.

g.text: B06 · Ordinary part histories and schema coverage
planned · PR #94 register: A16; child owners unassigned

rect.title: B06: Qualified sketches, constraints, expressions, cuts, revolutions, finishing operations, patterns and geometry pass held-out route acceptance.

g.text: B07 · Complete assembly, configuration and drawing semantics
planned · PR #94 register: A16; coordinate drawing PRs

rect.title: B07: Supported documents preserve all occurrences, mates, variants, dependencies, drawing dimensions and links through edit/rebuild and reopen.

g.text: B08 · Integrate existing native-format and evidence work
active · Each existing PR below owns its scoped delivery

rect.title: B08: Accepted implementations are integrated without reviving donor writers. Their exact capability limits enter B01 and B12.

g.text: planned · PR #94 register: A16 child claims

rect.title: B09: All nine roadmap families have qualified native reads and independent writes for their declared version scope.

g.text: B10 · CLI workflow and error usability

rect.title: B10: Representative users install, select formats, convert, inspect results and recover from refusal without undocumented assistance.

g.text: B11 · Documentation accuracy, accessibility and evaluation

rect.title: B11: Task guides match source and support limits. Rendered/narrow-view and representative-user findings are resolved or recorded explicitly.

g.text: planned · Unassigned release owner; reuse PR #94's A13 evidence

rect.title: B12: Every promised direction/version passes all CAD criteria on independent cases. Unsupported combinations refuse before output mutation.

g.text: B13 · Unattended research and operating evidence

rect.title: B13: The two-week pilot records recovery, parked jobs, interventions and independently accepted documents unlocked.

g.text: B14 · Release, runtime and security qualification
planned · Unassigned release owner; separate scoped PRs

rect.title: B14: Clean supported installations, runtime isolation, bounded inputs, destination safety, required security gates and reproducible release evidence pass.

g.text: A01 · Neutral contract and capability audit

rect.title: A01: Existing fields, demonstrated gaps, version scope and independent acceptance requirements documented

g.text: A02 · Pinned corpus and paired authoring specifications

rect.title: A02: Hashed inputs, actual measurements, missing dependencies and independent holdout families recorded

g.text: A03 · Durable evidence store and job controller

rect.title: A03: Transactional jobs, dependency invalidation, leases, bounded retries and interruption recovery verified remotely
A04: Initial sketches and feature variants preserve required semantics and report unresolved records accurately
A05: Equivalent initial designs serialize through the same contract with independently supported meaning
A06: Equal, intentionally different and ambiguous paired cases report correctly without broad identity masking

g.text: A07 · Bounded deterministic inference and priority scheduler

rect.title: A07: Real shared gaps yield traceable hypotheses, counterexamples and affected-file rescans without models

g.text: A08 · Controlled sample and trace workers

rect.title: A08: Exact recipes and versioned receipts work with healthy controls; absent workers block only dependent jobs

g.text: A09 · Scoped field maps and typed codec candidates

rect.title: A09: Solved pad-then-pad family is reproduced without model calls, with independent proof and zero donor blocks
A10: Models-off operation, fixed two-step escalation, a failure log, repeat-failure start-step routing, validated responses, cost limits and false-proposal rejection verified
A11: Qualified portable graphs generate native files without source replay, proprietary runtime or opaque replacements
A12: Qualified portable graphs generate native files from understood fields and reject unsupported required semantics

A13: Both routes match body count, volume, center of mass and feature history, preserve all required constraints/dependencies, and pass independent driving-parameter edits, restoration, rebuild and save/reopen with healthy controls

g.text: A14 · Independent remote compatibility and regression gates

rect.title: A14: Exact-revision checks reject stale receipts, shared-reader/writer mistakes and unsupported input through real boundaries

g.text: A15 · Unattended operation, reports and forecast pilot

rect.title: A15: Two-week operating evidence records recovery, no-progress parking, blockers and verified documents unlocked. Record model spend when enabled

g.text: A16 · Broader features and additional CAD families

rect.title: A16: Each scoped feature/version/route has independent native acceptance; FreeCAD and CATIA use the same contract
